tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor snying gi bdud rtsi bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/ blo ldan gang zhig dad pa mos gus lam gyi srog tu bzung nas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la skyabs gnas kun 'dus su shes pa'i sgo nas/ rnal 'byor zab mo sgom par 'dod pas/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ gdod nas rnam dag spros bral ngang las/ /gnas yul cir snang dag pa rab 'byams/ /bde chen zhing gi bkod pa yongs rdzogs/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho dkrigs pa'i dbus su/ /seng khri padma zla ba'i steng du/ /drin can bla ma mchog dang dbyer med/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bzang po/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ /chos gos rnam gsum sa zhu'i cod pan/ /mdzes par gsol bas dwang ba bskyed mdzad/ /chos 'chad phyag rgya thugs dkar mdzad pa'i/ /mtheb mdzub bar nas dgyes pa'i pad dkar/ /ze'u 'bru'i dbus gnas rdo rje dril bus/ /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med don ston/ /zhabs zung rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan pa'i 'od kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rtsa brgyud bla ma/ /yi dam lha tshogs rgyal ba sras bcas/ /chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ /kha ba bu yug 'tshub bzhin spyan drangs/ /rje btsun bla ma'i sku la thim pas/ /skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can gyur/ /de nas sde snod ma tshar gcig gis yan lag bdun pa dang / maṇḍal rgyas bsdus gang 'os skabs dang bstun par 'bul/ mos gus drag pos rab sde rba gsum tshig don rjes dran gyi ngang nas dag gsal snyan gsum dang ldan par bton rjes/ mdo rgyud kunaṃ gyi rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin nor bu'i dgaṃ' ston 'gyed/ /phan bde dpal 'byor bzaṃng poṃ stsol mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa la grangs bzung nas brgya stong sogs gang mang gsog mthar/

mdun gyi bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /rdo rje gsum dang sgo gsum dbyer med ngang / /dbang dang dngos grub thams cad legs thob cing / /rang sems bla ma'i rang zhal mngon du gyur/ /zhes brjod nas/ bla ma'i sku bzhi'i ngo bo skyong / skye ba kun tu sogs bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab ste chos mthun gyi spyod pas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni smad shod rdzong gsar dgon pa'i dge slong kun dga' phun tshogs kyi zhal snga nas nan tan chen pos bskul zhing / nya cher spam 'dzang dgon pa'i dge slong mkhyen rab tshul khrims nas kyang nyams len bde ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba gnyis ka'i dgongs pa cig car bsgrub pa'i phyir du/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i rjes 'jug gi tshul tsam zhig 'dzin pa shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas drwa sgang sgrub sde bsam gtan phun tshogs gling du bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 /sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor snying gi bdud rtsi/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
